  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MARCH 25, 2022

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Himmelrich at 9:18 a.m.,
  on Friday, March 25, 2022, via teleconference pursuant to Assembly Bill No. 361 signed by, Governor Gavin
  Newsome at https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/ejwfqbjh.
  .

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Sue Himmelrich
  Mayor Pro Tem Kristin McCowan
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  Assistant City Manager Susan Cline
  Special Counsel Alan Seltzer
  Assistant City Clerk Nikima Newsome

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 9:18 a.m., with all
  members present.

  AGENDA  Motion by Councilmember Davis, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem McCowan,
  MANAGEMENT  to hear public comment first and then hear Item 4.A. before Closed Sessions.
  The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers de la Torre, Brock, Negrete, Davis, Parra
  Mayor Pro Tem McCowan, Mayor Himmelrich
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  STUDY SESSION:  4.A.  Council Retreat, was presented.
  COUNCIL RETREAT
  Recommended Action
  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  1. Review and discuss the City Council Rules of Order and Procedure;
  and
  2. Collaboratively develop agreements for implementing rules for
  meetings.

  1  March 25, 2022
 DocuSign Envelope ID: B83A7390-E2AC-44C6-BFFA-31C0B1A74DD9

  There was no one present for public comment on this item.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.
  (Councilmember Brock was
  excused at 1:24 p.m.)  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 1:00 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 1:39 p.m., with all members present except
  Councilmember Brock, to report the following:

  1.A. Public Employee Appointment:
  Title – City Attorney

  The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable
  action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 1:39 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Sue Himmelrich
  Assistant City Clerk  Mayor

  2  March 25, 2022
